remedy.text: Consumers should immediately stop using the crib mattresses and contact Criblike for instructions on requesting a full refund. Consumers should destroy the mattresses by cutting them in half, take a photo of the destroyed mattress and email the photo to Criblike-service_2025@outlook.com with 'Recall Proof' and your name in the subject line.
